purpose: Portable examples for checking selective teaching and provider-tool offers.

scenarios.prompt: Explain how this repo wants agents to work. I am new to AI coding agents.
expect: defines the workflow in plain terms

scenarios.prompt: Fix the typo in README.md only.
This is a long migration. Keep going until tests pass and report checkpoints.
Make my vague feature request better before I give it to an agent.
expect: returns Goal, Context, Constraints, Done-when, and Validation
mentions one useful provider-native tool only if it fits

scenarios.prompt: Rename this one local variable in utils.ts.
reject: suggests a hook, skill, or /goal for a one-line change

expect: routes through MISSIONS.md to the compass-adopt playbook
installs the fit-based subset, not every skill
ends with verification and a completion-gate report
reject: asks a questionnaire the scripts could answer
copies all skills regardless of stack
commits or pushes without being asked

scenarios.prompt: Bootstrap a new invoicing API from the attached architecture notes.
expect: routes through MISSIONS.md to the compass-bootstrap playbook
derives an answers file from the guidelines and records assumptions
stops for plan approval before writing code
reject: runs the interactive questionnaire at the user
scaffolds before the spec and plan exist
ignores guidelines that fall outside preset choices instead of labeling deviations
